app.name: Pitchforge ERP
app.tagline: One system for sales, projects and the books.

errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account is locked after too many attempts. Ask an administrator to unlock it.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password do not match.
errors.INVALID_TWO_FACTOR_CODE: That code is not valid. Check your authenticator app and try again.
errors.PERIOD_LOCKED: This period is locked. Ask a Partner to reopen it.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.SOD_VIOLATION: You cannot approve your own request.
errors.STALE_VERSION: Someone else changed this record. Reload it and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This record does not exist, or you cannot see it.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This record has moved on. Reload it to see its current state.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
twoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

enrol.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
enrol.description: Your role needs a second step at sign-in. Add this key to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
enrol.recoveryDescription: Each code works once, if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.description: Enter your email and we will send a link that works for 30 minutes.
reset.sentDescription: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.

sessionExpired.title: Your session has ended
sessionExpired.description: For your security, you are signed out after 60 minutes without activity.

shell.unread: {count, plural, =0 {No unread notifications} one {# unread notification} other {# unread notifications}}

home.partnerDescription: Financial year 2026–27 to date. Every figure comes from the ledger.
home.financeDescription: Cash, payables and receivables that need you.
home.employeeDescription: Your tasks, time, leave and payslips. Company finance is hidden for your role.

section.placeholderDescription: Screens are built against the contracts in packages/contracts.
section.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this page
section.forbiddenDescription: Ask an administrator if you need it.

states.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this
states.forbiddenDescription: Ask an administrator if you need it.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.description: This action needs your password again. You will not be asked for the next five minutes.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.description: For your security, you will be signed out in five minutes unless you continue.

appError.title: This page could not be shown
appError.description: Something went wrong while loading it. Your work elsewhere is not affected.

search.label: Search records
search.title: Search
search.description: Search covers every record you are allowed to see.
search.emptyDescription: Try a document number, a client or a person’s name.

account.title: Your account
account.description: Your sign-in details and the devices that are signed in.
account.name: Name
account.sessionsDescription: Sign out any device you do not recognise.
account.passwordDescription: At least 12 characters. Every other device is signed out afterwards.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: One approval engine for bills, claims, journals, drawings, payment runs, purchases, quotations, timesheets and leave. Nobody approves their own request.
approvals.emptyMine: You have not submitted anything that needs approval.
approvals.postingNote: Calculated by the posting engine. Approval and posting are saved in one transaction.
approvals.attachments: {count, plural, =0 {No attachments} one {# attachment, virus-scanned} other {# attachments, virus-scanned}}
approvals.ownRequest: You requested this, so you cannot approve it.
approvals.ownRequestDetail: Segregation of duties: another approver must decide.
approvals.reasonHint: Tell the requester what to change. They will see this.
approvals.reasonInvalid: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.
approvals.rejected: Rejected. The requester is told why.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every change to every business record, with who, when and from where. Nobody can edit or delete it.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Users, roles, approval rules and company settings. Changes here are audited.
admin.name: Name
admin.subject: Reminder

finance.title: Payables and bank
finance.billsHint: Bills post to payables when a Partner approves them.
finance.newBillDescription: Saved as a draft. VAT, totals and the posting come from the server.
finance.grossByServer: The gross amount and the journal are worked out by the server when you save.
finance.postingNote: From the posting engine. Nothing posts until a Partner approves.
finance.runsHint: One run pays many bills from one account. Someone other than its preparer approves it.
finance.newRunDescription: Choose bills that are ready to pay. Withholding is worked out by the server.
finance.runSod: The person who prepares a payment run cannot approve it.
finance.nothingToPay: No bills are ready to pay.
finance.adviceReady: The bank advice file is ready.
finance.withholdingByServer: TDS and VDS come from the withholding rules on the server.
finance.ageingDescription: What we owe, by how late it is.
finance.noStatementLines: No statement imported for this account.
finance.postLine: Post an entry for this line
finance.postLineDescription: For charges, interest and settlements the ledger does not have yet.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.immutable: Posted entries cannot be edited or deleted.
ledger.reverseHint: A new entry with the opposite lines is posted today. The original stays as it is.
ledger.manualHint: Every manual journal needs a Partner’s approval before it posts.
ledger.newJvDescription: Saved as a draft. The server checks that it balances when you submit.
ledger.jvNote: Submitting checks the balance, the period and the accounts on the server.
ledger.balanceByServer: Totals are checked by the server; the entry is refused if debits and credits differ.
ledger.chartHint: Accounts marked “posted by the system” take entries only from the posting engine.
ledger.name: Name
ledger.reopened: Period reopened. Every Partner is told.
ledger.reopenDescription: Only a Partner can reopen a locked period, and it is audited. You will confirm your password.
